name: eq_pow_order_mul_iterate_dslope
statement: HasFPowerSeriesAt f p z₀) : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 z₀, f z = (z - z₀) ^ p.order • (swap dslope z₀)^[p.order] f z

name: locally_ne_zero

name: eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_smul_eq_zero
statement: 𝕜 → A} {g : 𝕜 → B} (hf : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 f U) (hg : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g U) (hfg : ∀ z ∈ U, f z • g z = 0) (hU : IsPreconnected U) : (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0) ∨ (∀ z ∈ U, g z = 0)
